verdict.rationale: Airbyte's own docs and repo say it loads into data warehouses, data lakes and databases through a large connector catalog, and typing/deduping describes consistent one-to-one table mapping in the warehouse. However, none of the named destinations is explicitly evidenced, and nothing shows that switching destinations leaves the pipeline unchanged. missing for 10: explicit evidence of Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres and object-storage destination connectors, documentation that destinations can be swapped without changing pipelines, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-destination loading.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I load to the major warehouses and lakes — Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, object storage — without changing pipelines

citations.quote: Airbyte provides a catalog of 600+ connectors for APIs, databases, data warehouses, data lakes
Consolidate data from hundreds of sources into your data warehouses, data lakes, and databases.
One-to-one table mapping: Data in one stream will always be mapped to one table in your data warehouse. No more sub-tables.
